Precomputed embeddings of 600 feedback messages

Source: R/data.R
feedback_embeddings.Rd

feedback_embeddings is a matrix of Sentence-BERT embeddings of the first 600 distinct English translations of feedback_translations, in order of first appearance. They let topic models be fitted, compared, and inspected without downloading a model, and they are the embeddings used by the examples and articles of the package.

Row i is the embedding of row i of head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600). Pass the matrix as embeddings = to topics(), compare_topics(), or topic_corpus() together with that data frame.

Usage

feedback_embeddings

Format

A numeric matrix with 600 rows (messages) and 384 columns (embedding dimensions). Rows are L2-normalized and rounded to four decimals.

Source

Encoded with the pinned sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model (revision 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41) by data-raw/feedback_embeddings.R. Encoding the same messages with encode() gives the same embeddings up to the rounding.

See also

feedback_translations, topics(), encode().

Examples

dim(feedback_embeddings)
#> [1] 600 384

corpus <- head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600)
topic_model <- topics(corpus, n_topics = 6, column = "translation",
                      embeddings = feedback_embeddings)
topic_sizes(topic_model, weights = "n")
#>   topic                                                       label n_documents
#> 1     1   Where is the cow and the cake? Choose all the pictures...         223
#> 2     2            All the ones between the cat and the strawberry.         133
#> 3     3         What does “all the ones between the leaf and the...         131
#> 4     4 Are you sure you have fewer pictures in the red box than...          49
#> 5     5      In the top middle box, it means something is in the...          37
#> 6     6    It is not a person, does not have a hat, and is sitting.          27
#>   proportion n_weighted weighted_share
#> 1 0.37166667        267     0.36081081
#> 2 0.22166667        162     0.21891892
#> 3 0.21833333        138     0.18648649
#> 4 0.08166667         76     0.10270270
